description: pLDDT profiles of LPX2, its paralog EIS1 and the genuine alpha/beta hydrolase LPX1, with GxSxG motif positions and UniProt disordered regions marked
code:
import requests, json, re, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# --- pull everything needed again (executor state does not persist) ---
def up(acc):
    return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()
def af(acc):
    m=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=120).json()[0]
    return requests.get(m["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
def plddt(p):
    return {int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in p.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}

lpx2=up("P35736"); seq=lpx2["sequence"]["value"]
pl=plddt(af("P35736")); pv=np.array([pl[i] for i in sorted(pl)])
pl1=plddt(af("Q12405")); pv1=np.array([pl1[i] for i in sorted(pl1)])   # LPX1, real alpha/beta hydrolase
ple=plddt(af("Q05050")); pve=np.array([ple[i] for i in sorted(ple)])   # EIS1

gx=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=G.S.G)',seq)]
gx1=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=G.S.G)',up("Q12405")["sequence"]["value"])]
dis=[(1,27),(34,53),(687,730),(751,778),(791,821),(834,922)]   # UniProt disordered regions

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,9),sharex=False)

for ax,(v,lab,gxs,extra) in zip(axes,[
    (pv,"LPX2 / YKL050C (P35736), 922 aa",gx,dis),
    (pve,"EIS1 / YMR031C (Q05050), 843 aa, WGD paralog",[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=G.S.G)',up("Q05050")["sequence"]["value"])],None),
    (pv1,"LPX1 / YOR084W (Q12405), 387 aa, crystallised alpha/beta hydrolase (PDB 2Y6V)",gx1,None)]):
    x=np.arange(1,len(v)+1)
    ax.fill_between(x,0,v,color="#4C78A8",lw=0)
    ax.axhline(70,color="#888",ls="--",lw=1)
    ax.axhline(50,color="#bbb",ls=":",lw=1)
    if extra:
        for a,b in extra: ax.axvspan(a,b,color="#F58518",alpha=0.18,lw=0)
    for g in gxs:
        ax.plot([g+2],[v[g+1] if g+1<len(v) else v[-1]],marker="v",color="#E45756",ms=9,zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(f"GxSxG {g}",(g+2,v[g+1]),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,12),
                    ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#E45756")
    ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,len(v))
    ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_title(lab,fontsize=10,loc="left")
axes[2].set_xlabel("residue")
axes[0].text(0.99,0.92,"orange = UniProt disordered regions; dashed line = pLDDT 70",
             transform=axes[0].transAxes,ha="right",fontsize=8,color="#444")
fig.suptitle("The single GxSxG in LPX2 lies in a disordered, very-low-confidence C-terminal tail",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("LPX2 GxSxG at %s, motif %s, pLDDT of the 5 motif residues: %s"
      % (gx, [seq[g-1:g+4] for g in gx], [pl[i] for i in range(gx[0],gx[0]+5)]))
print("LPX2 mean pLDDT %.1f ; fraction <70 %.1f%%" % (pv.mean(),(pv<70).mean()*100))
print("EIS1 mean pLDDT %.1f ; fraction <70 %.1f%%" % (pve.mean(),(pve<70).mean()*100))
print("LPX1 mean pLDDT %.1f ; fraction <70 %.1f%%" % (pv1.mean(),(pv1<70).mean()*100))
